risk_note: RV2 (identity deletion flow + notification + app.module). BR-TEXT-23 / BR-ID-27: DELETION_PROGRESS inbox notices — requested (cooling, {cancel_deadline}), cancelled (withdrawn), cancelled_negative (cooling ended with a negative balance; amount = −available_fen read in the same transaction, formatYuan). Written in the business transaction through a notification function exported from notification/index.ts and injected by app.module into identity's port (identity never imports notification); notify_logs dedupe key {deletion_request_id}:DELETION_PROGRESS:{variant} in the same transaction, so a rollback leaves neither row (orchestrator 09:5x). Inbox only, no push or SMS. Replaces three TODOs blocked on B1-15i. Rule tests attempt 2 flattened three describe blocks to top-level it (test-guard) and took property runs / seed from @couli/testing; reordered before the implementation, red at the new spec PASS 46. verify:fast green; full verification on the AWS test machine hit the 3600 s limit on unrelated slow tests, all 5 of this task's rule-test files and its unit tests were green in that log with no failures; required CI checks run on the PR head.
